```pddl
BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain floor-tile)
  (:requirements :strips :typing :action-costs)
  (:types tile robot color)
  (:predicates
    (robot-at ?r - robot ?t - tile)
    (robot-has ?r - robot ?c - color)
    (available-color ?c - color)
    (clear ?t - tile)
    (painted ?t - tile ?c - color)
    (up ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    (down ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    (right ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    (left ?from - tile ?to - tile)
  )
  (:functions
    (total-cost) - number
  )

  ;; Change spray gun color
  (:action change-color
    :parameters (?r - robot ?old - color ?new - color)
    :precondition (and
      (robot-has ?r ?old)
      (available-color ?new)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (robot-has ?r ?old))
      (robot-has ?r ?new)
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )

  ;; Paint tile up from robot
  (:action paint-up
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - tile ?to - tile ?c - color)
    :precondition (and
      (robot-at ?r ?from)
      (up ?from ?to)
      (clear ?to)
      (robot-has ?r ?c)
    )
    :effect (and
      (painted ?to ?c)
      (not (clear ?to))
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )

  ;; Paint tile down from robot
  (:action paint-down
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - tile ?to - tile ?c - color)
    :precondition (and
      (robot-at ?r ?from)
      (down ?from ?to)
      (clear ?to)
      (robot-has ?r ?c)
    )
    :effect (and
      (painted ?to ?c)
      (not (clear ?to))
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )

  ;; Move up
  (:action move-up
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    :precondition (and
      (robot-at ?r ?from)
      (up ?from ?to)
      (clear ?to)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (robot-at ?r ?from))
      (robot-at ?r ?to)
      (clear ?from)
      (not (clear ?to))
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )

  ;; Move down
  (:action move-down
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    :precondition (and
      (robot-at ?r ?from)
      (down ?from ?to)
      (clear ?to)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (robot-at ?r ?from))
      (robot-at ?r ?to)
      (clear ?from)
      (not (clear ?to))
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )

  ;; Move right
  (:action move-right
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    :precondition (and
      (robot-at ?r ?from)
      (right ?from ?to)
      (clear ?to)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (robot-at ?r ?from))
      (robot-at ?r ?to)
      (clear ?from)
      (not (clear ?to))
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )

  ;; Move left
  (:action move-left
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - tile ?to - tile)
    :precondition (and
      (robot-at ?r ?from)
      (left ?from ?to)
      (clear ?to)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (robot-at ?r ?from))
      (robot-at ?r ?to)
      (clear ?from)
      (not (clear ?to))
      (increase (total-cost) 1)
    )
  )
)
END DOMAIN
